items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: I worked with her, but also we worked at little jobs, a long time ago, the three of us.

ctx.x: She was a singer. A very -- I worked with her, but also we worked at little jobs, a long time ago, the three of us. And incidentally, Sam McDaniels worked with us. He was also very popular when I first came here. Hattie McDaniels' brother. He was a drummer and a terrific entertainer. He had a terrific following.

But there was another woman also. In fact there were two other women. One of them has gone on. Her name was Lottie Gozier. Well, Lottie was a marvelous pianist, and she and Roberta and another woman named Ruth Lee, they tell me they worked together, and I think they recorded. I think the three of them -- Roberta recorded alone, but I think the three of them made records together or something, and they were very, very popular.
